headline: Brazil wants to play against Bangladesh in October
summary: The five-time World Cup champions have proposed a match in Dhaka on October 5 or 6.
details: The Brazil national football team has expressed interest in visiting Dhaka to play a match against Bangladesh after the FIFA Asian Cup.
The five-time World Cup champions have proposed organizing the match on either October 5 or 6.
Brazil intends to bring a contingent of approximately 90 members to Dhaka for the event.
This potential match would mark a significant milestone for football in Bangladesh, bringing one of the world's most successful teams to the country.
caption:
Brazil is coming to Dhaka? 🇧🇷

The Brazil national football team has expressed interest in visiting Dhaka to play a match against Bangladesh after the FIFA Asian Cup.

The five-time World Cup champions have proposed organizing the match on either October 5 or 6.

Brazil intends to bring a contingent of approximately 90 members to Dhaka for the event.

This potential match would mark a significant milestone for football in Bangladesh, bringing one of the world's most successful teams to the country.

headline_marked: High Court to [[deliver verdict on Nusrat murder case]] today
headline: High Court to deliver verdict on Nusrat murder case today
summary: The court will rule on death references, appeals, and jail appeals of the convicts in the high-profile murder of the madrasa student.
details: The High Court is set to announce its verdict today, Monday, August 24, on the death references and appeals of the convicts in the Nusrat Jahan Rafi murder case.
The verdict will be delivered by a bench of Justice Bhishmadev Chakraborty and Justice K.M. Rasheduzzaman Raja.
In October 2019, the Feni Women and Children Repression Prevention Tribunal had sentenced 16 people to death for the murder of the madrasa student from Sonagazi, Feni.
Among the convicts, Siraj Ud-daula, former Sonagazi Upazila Awami League president Ruhul Amin, and Sonagazi municipality councillor Maksudul Alam were among those sentenced to death.
The state's side presented their paper-book during the hearings that began last week.
Security has been tightened around the victim's family home in Feni to maintain order during the verdict announcement.
caption:
A long-awaited verdict is coming today. The High Court will rule on the death sentences of 16 convicts in the Nusrat Jahan Rafi murder case.

The High Court is set to announce its verdict today, Monday, August 24, on the death references and appeals of the convicts in the Nusrat Jahan Rafi murder case.

The verdict will be delivered by a bench of Justice Bhishmadev Chakraborty and Justice K.M. Rasheduzzaman Raja.

In October 2019, the Feni Women and Children Repression Prevention Tribunal had sentenced 16 people to death for the murder of the madrasa student from Sonagazi, Feni.

Among the convicts, Siraj Ud-daula, former Sonagazi Upazila Awami League president Ruhul Amin, and Sonagazi municipality councillor Maksudul Alam were among those sentenced to death.

The state's side presented their paper-book during the hearings that began last week.

Security has been tightened around the victim's family home in Feni to maintain order during the verdict announcement.

#NusratJahanRafi #JusticeForNusrat #HighCourt #Bangladesh #Feni #LegalVerdict

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo
